title: Wild seeds: East Blue (Conomi, Orange Town, Loguetown)
notes: Break grass, ferns and wild plants on East Blue (Conomi, Orange Town, Loguetown): now and then a seed drops.
A grown crop drops more seeds. Bank one in a Seed Vault to draw a free seed every day.

title: Farming
notes: Grow East Blue Cabbage on farmland. Fastest on East Blue (Conomi, Orange Town, Loguetown).
Sprinklers, the Watering Can and Ranch Manure speed it up.
